articles.titre: Australia flash PMI sinks to 46.1 as private sector shrinks at fastest pace in 5 years
articles.resume: A drop this deep, alongside the first easing in input cost inflation for months, weakens the case for further Australian monetary tightening. That leaves the Australian dollar exposed if rate markets start pricing a gentler path. The sharp fall in new export orders also points to softening external demand, at a time when global equities are already under heavy pressure. Prices are still running above their long-run averages, though, so policymakers are unlikely to move quickly to declare inflation beaten. articles.titre: New Zealand retail volumes jump 2.2% in Q3, more than four times the expected pace
articles.resume: A beat of this size is supportive for the New Zealand dollar and should firm rate expectations at the margin, since it weakens the case that NZ consumers need more help. Any boost may be short-lived, though, with global risk appetite under heavy pressure after last week's Wall Street rout. A high-beta currency like the kiwi tends to follow broader sentiment in that kind of market. Liquidity is also thinner than usual with Tokyo closed , which can exaggerate the first move in either direction. ---- New Zealand consumers didn't just recover in the third quarter, they outran forecasts by a wide margin, putting a firmer floor under the growth outlook.
